Step {{ step }} of 2: Telemetry report configuration

The telemetry module sends anonymous data about this storage cluster to the configured telemetry endpoint to help analyze usage patterns and operational issues.
Submitted data can be visualized on the configured public dashboards to review summary statistics such as the number of reporting clusters, total capacity, OSD counts, and version distribution trends.

The data being reported does not contain any sensitive data like pool names, object names, object contents, hostnames, or device serial numbers. It contains counters and statistics on how the cluster has been deployed, the software version, the distribution of the hosts and other parameters needed for capacity and behavior analysis. The data is sent secured to {{ sendToUrl }} and {{ sendToDeviceUrl }} (device report).

The plugin is already enabled. Click Deactivate to disable it. 
Channels

The telemetry report is broken down into several "channels", each with a different type of information that can be configured below.

Contact Information Submitting any contact information is completely optional and disabled by default.
